Current Process: Requests are accepted through email and support channels
Gap Identified: Manual tracking may cause missed deadlines or incomplete responses
Recommended Action: Implement centralized DSAR tracking with automated deadline alerts

Current Process: Users may request correction through support
Gap Identified: Correction evidence is not consistently retained
Recommended Action: Retain before-and-after correction evidence and closure records

Current Process: Deletion requests are routed to system owners
Recommended Action: Create an end-to-end deletion checklist and retain evidence from each system

Current Process: Requests are handled manually by privacy and system teams
Gap Identified: Restriction status may not be consistently applied across systems
Recommended Action: Implement centralized restriction tracking and verify downstream enforcement

Current Process: Customer data can be exported from major systems
Gap Identified: Export procedures are not formally documented
Recommended Action: Document the portability process and test export completeness

Current Process: Marketing opt-outs are supported but broader objections are handled manually
Gap Identified: Objection records are fragmented across systems
Recommended Action: Centralize objection tracking and verify suppression across systems

Gap Identified: Formal review procedures and safeguards are not fully documented
Recommended Action: Create documented procedures for automated decision reviews and human intervention

Current Process: Employee requests are routed through HR
Recommended Action: Continue documenting request response and closure evidence

Current Process: Applicants may request deletion of recruitment data
Gap Identified: Deletion from integrated recruiting systems may not be independently validated
Recommended Action: Verify deletion across recruiting systems and retain evidence

Current Process: Customers can update some profile information directly
Users can unsubscribe from marketing communications
Recommended Action: Continue maintaining suppression lists and consent history

Current Process: Privacy team can request temporary restriction
Gap Identified: Restriction controls depend on manual coordination
Recommended Action: Create standard restriction workflow with system-owner confirmation

Current Process: Data can be exported but format varies by system
Gap Identified: Export formats and completeness are inconsistent
Recommended Action: Standardize portable export formats and document validation

Current Process: Privacy team tracks open requests manually
Gap Identified: Deadlines could be missed because reminders are manual
Recommended Action: Implement automated request deadline and escalation tracking

Current Process: Requests are closed after response is sent
Recommended Action: Maintain centralized closure evidence including response date and approver
